paras: The Alpha-N Carbon Rear Underbody Floor Kit is designed to fit the BMW M2 G87 2023+, and is available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, this two-piece underbody system brings true motorsport-inspired aerodynamic engineering to the latest M2 platform.

Designed to work in combination with the Alpha-N Carbon Rear Diffuser, the underbody floor kit smooths airflow beneath the rear of the vehicle and directs it toward the diffuser area reducing drag and increasing rear-end stability at speed. The extended underbody panels create a more continuous aerodynamic surface, improving airflow efficiency while visually complementing aggressive rear aero upgrades.
hl: Manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance
